cosmicRules.magic: Magic destabilizes near rifts; spells may duplicate, invert, or collapse.
cosmicRules.space: Spatial fractures cause looping paths, sudden folds, and void drops.
cosmicRules.time: Temporal echoes repeat events or skip forward unpredictably.
cosmicRules.travel: Movement requires Riftseeker anchors or stable Riftspire pathways.
